description: Flying from 1966, its J58 engines functioned as ramjets at speed, and its titanium skin grew inches from heat expansion. The program produced 4 major variants: SR-71A, SR-71B (trainer), A-12 (CIA predecessor), YF-12 (interceptor prototype). It set the absolute speed record (3,529 km/h) and the altitude record for sustained flight (85,069 ft), both still standing.
